verdict.rationale: Multiple docs describe automatic skill-triggering: SessionStart hooks inject skill context at session start across harnesses (Devin, Hermes, Antigravity), the using-superpowers SKILL.md instructs the agent to invoke relevant skills before any action, and GitHub README states 'because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special.' Community evidence (HN) corroborates the workflow actually running (brainstorm→review→TDD sequence observed) though some users note reduced value/extra mistakes, which is a quality concern not a contradiction of the triggering mechanism itself. Missing for 10: independent measurement of trigger precision/false-positive rate and confirmation that descriptions are deliberately 'engineered' rather than just documented behavior.
